fixtures.trigger_explanation: Low-consequence generative assistance; canonical core only. No conditional profile is necessary from the stated facts.

Autonomous enterprise agent performs consequential digital execution. Profile C applies.
Delegated multi-agent workflow with consequential execution. Profiles B and C apply.
Physical AI perception is material and human reliance can produce consequential operational effect. Profiles C and D apply; direct actuation is not assumed.
Directly actuated Physical AI produces material physical effects. Profiles C and D apply.
Governance responsibility and evidence dependency are divided between provider/customer roles. Profile G applies.
Material incident caused suspension and governed restart across an authorization boundary. Profiles A, E, and F apply.
